entries.6a382b2c03fe986d: This business acquires land, constructs buildings and sells them as condominiums or sells them in bulk, and also owns and leases office buildings and other properties. It develops its own-brand condominium series "EXCELLENT CITY"; the subsidiary Shinnihon Community handles condominium and building management and leasing management, and Shinnihon Fudosan is responsible for owning and leasing the head office building. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥54,807 million.

entries.75471cd0822cd8f0: This business undertakes building and civil engineering works, covering planning, design and construction. The subsidiary Kenken undertakes building and civil engineering works using precast and prestressed concrete members as the main materials, and seismic reinforcement works using the outframe method; Shinnihon Community handles large-scale repair work on condominiums and other works. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥83,620 million, the largest of the 2 reportable segments.
